content.short: Civic is an end-to-end identity and access management service for dApps.
content.description: Civic delivers blockchain identity management tools that enable secure, private, multi-chain identity handling with an on-chain representation of their reusable identity. Its flagship product, Civic Pass, provides an integrated permissioning layer to help organizations secure access to on-chain assets. Users can also manage their identity, presence, and reputation with Civic.me. Civic aims to shape a future where everyone has access to a trusted identity solution. All components are designed to work together in secure, privacy-preserving ways to support broad adoption of trusted digital identity.
